rules.name: DirectX shader cache
rules.hint: Clears the Windows DirectX shader cache. Games rebuild it, so the next launch of each game may stutter briefly.
rules.description: Deletes the system DirectX shader cache in %LOCALAPPDATA%\D3DSCache. It is useful after a driver update or when a game shows corrupted shaders. Games recompile shaders on the next launch, which can cause short stutters at first. The cache rebuilds itself.
rules.sideEffects: Shaders are rebuilt on next launch; expect brief stutter the first time.

rules.name: NVIDIA shader caches
rules.hint: Clears NVIDIA DXCache, GLCache and NV_Cache. Useful after driver updates; first game launches rebuild shaders.
rules.description: Deletes the NVIDIA driver shader caches (DXCache, GLCache, NV_Cache). Clearing them after a driver update avoids stale shaders. Games rebuild the cache on the next launch, which can cause brief stutter. Files the driver has open are skipped.
rules.sideEffects: Shaders are rebuilt on next launch; expect brief stutter the first time.

rules.name: NVIDIA driver extraction folder
rules.hint: Removes leftover NVIDIA driver installer files in C:\NVIDIA. Installed drivers are not affected.
rules.description: The NVIDIA installer unpacks each driver into C:\NVIDIA and leaves the files behind. Deleting them frees space without touching the installed driver. Reinstalling a driver extracts a fresh copy.

rules.name: AMD shader caches
rules.hint: Clears AMD DirectX, DXC, OpenGL and Vulkan shader caches. First game launches rebuild shaders.
rules.description: Deletes the AMD driver shader caches. Clearing them after a driver update avoids stale shaders. Games rebuild them on the next launch, which can cause brief stutter.
rules.sideEffects: Shaders are rebuilt on next launch; expect brief stutter the first time.

rules.name: Intel graphics shader cache
rules.hint: Clears the Intel graphics (Arc and iGPU) shader cache. First game launches rebuild shaders.
rules.description: Deletes the Intel graphics driver shader cache. Clearing it after a driver update avoids stale shaders. Games rebuild it on the next launch, which can cause brief stutter.
rules.sideEffects: Shaders are rebuilt on next launch; expect brief stutter the first time.

rules.name: Steam shader cache (all libraries)
rules.hint: Clears Steam's pre-compiled shader caches in every library. Steam must be closed; it re-downloads as needed.
rules.description: Deletes steamapps\shadercache in each Steam library found in libraryfolders.vdf. Steam downloads or rebuilds shaders on the next launch of each game, so first launches can stutter. Steam must be closed; iG Windows Tuner never closes it for you.
rules.sideEffects: Shaders are re-downloaded or rebuilt; expect brief stutter the first time.

rules.name: Steam web cache
rules.hint: Clears the Steam client's web cache (store, community pages). Steam must be closed. Fixes slow or blank pages.
rules.description: Deletes %LOCALAPPDATA%\Steam\htmlcache, the embedded browser cache that the Steam client uses for its store and community pages. It is rebuilt automatically and often fixes blank or slow pages. Steam must be closed.
rules.sideEffects: You may need to sign in to some web parts of Steam again.

rules.name: Steam logs and crash dumps
rules.hint: Removes Steam client log files and crash dumps older than a day. Steam must be closed.
rules.description: Deletes the Steam client logs and dumps folders in the Steam installation. They are only needed when Steam Support asks for them. Deleted logs cannot be restored.

rules.name: Epic Games Launcher cache and logs
rules.hint: Clears the Epic Games Launcher web cache and logs. The launcher must be closed. Fixes some launcher glitches.
rules.description: Deletes the Epic Games Launcher web caches and log files. The launcher rebuilds them on the next start. Epic Support recommends clearing the webcache folders for display problems.

rules.name: Battle.net cache and logs
rules.hint: Clears Battle.net app caches and logs. Battle.net and its Agent must be closed.
rules.description: Deletes the Battle.net desktop app cache and log folders, which Blizzard Support suggests clearing for launcher problems. They are rebuilt on the next start.

rules.name: EA app cache and logs
rules.hint: Clears the EA app cache and logs. The EA app must be closed.
rules.description: Deletes the EA app (EA Desktop) cache and log folders. They are rebuilt on the next start, which can fix stuck downloads and display problems.

rules.name: Ubisoft Connect cache and logs
rules.hint: Clears the Ubisoft Connect launcher cache and logs. The launcher must be closed.
rules.description: Deletes the Ubisoft Connect launcher cache and log folders. They are rebuilt on the next start. Game installations and saves are not touched.
